title: Reinhold Schmidt hears saucer occupants speaking High German

tellings.quote: is what he claims. He says, "I realized these guys were speaking in high German to each other,
>> the ship was from the outside a complete solid uh piece of aluminum or highly polished steel.
tellings.difference: Schmidt speaks firsthand and describes the ship's polished-metal exterior and its interior, not the occupants speaking High German.
tellings.link_reason: This is the same 1957 Nebraska saucer encounter that telling 3 describes, told by Schmidt himself.

as_told.title: Reinhold Schmidt describes the saucer interior

plain: A man named Reinhold Schmidt claimed that in 1957 in Nebraska he met the crew of a landed saucer and realised 'these guys were speaking in High German to each other,' as the researcher Jason Jorjani retells it. In a recording played on the episode, Schmidt himself describes the ship as 'a complete solid piece of aluminum or highly polished steel' from outside. Jorjani raises it because it could link the saucers to a secret German program.
